brief: Hoo! Let’s step off the Reading Road and into Narnia. In Chapter 7, the Beavers make the children a warm dinner. Build the Beavers’ dinner, then take a photo for your teacher.
mapday: No headset today? It’s Road Map Day. Read each sentence and decide: is it in the book, or not? Then finish two sentences about Aslan and Edmund.
extra: Add a Medieval Hatchet. Say how Mr. Beaver used it to get fish.
step1: These are your five models. Say each name out loud. This list is also in VR, in the Canvas tab.
step2: Put on your headset and open the On-Demand app. Click Explore, type today’s map in Filter environments, and click it. Then click Begin Solo.
step3: Press the top button on your right controller and click Models. Put the fire down first. Put the rocking chair beside it. Put the table near the fire and the pot on it. Put the net nearby.
step4: Point to the table and say this out loud. The Beavers help the children because… Edmund is quiet because…
step5: Stand back so it all fits. Open your menu: Library, then Camera, then Take photo. Click the Canvas tab, pick this week’s VR assignment, and click Choose from My Files. Pick your photo, click Use this file, then Submit to Canvas. Look for the green Submitted tag. Then press the Meta button and click Quit.
